current_evidence: The council's own document, 'Validation checklist requirements for planning applications submitted to Warrington Borough Council', states it was adopted 28 March 2024 and adds BNG and other new items, so it supersedes the June 2020 (amended 19 Oct 2023) version. A replacement 'Validation Checklist - Consultation Draft February 2026' went out to consultation from 5 March to 17 April 2026, but the consultation page does not show any adoption.

issues.detail: Grokbot links the June 2020 checklist (amended 19 October 2023). The council adopted a replacement checklist on 28 March 2024, with 45 local items against 36 in the old version. A further 2026 draft has also been consulted on.
issues.evidence: Adopted Validation Checklist - 28-3-24.pdf: 'Adopted 28 March 2024'; also see warrington.gov.uk/local-validation-checklist-2026-consultation (5 Mar - 17 Apr 2026, closed)

issues.detail: The list date 2023-10-01 comes from the upload folder in the URL. The filename says 'amended Sept 23', but the document text says it was amended 19 October 2023. Neither is the date of the current list, which is 28 March 2024.
issues.grok_comment: At month precision, 2023-10-01 matches the linked document's own "June 2020 (amended 19 October 2023)", so the date is right for that file. The valid point is that a newer list, adopted 28 March 2024, has superseded it.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. The date is right for that file, but the file has been superseded by the 28 March 2024 list (now an outdated-link issue).

issues.detail: Grokbot missed many named local requirements that are in both the 2023 and the 2024 lists. Affordable Housing Statement (major residential). Air Quality Assessment (in or near AQMAs, or above Transport Assessment thresholds). Archaeological Assessment (on or adjacent to archaeological heritage assets). Battery Energy Storage Statement (1MW+). Coal Mining Risk Assessment (Coal Authority High Risk areas, excluding change of use and reserved matters). Crime Impact Assessment (major residential 10+, education, commercial, leisure, takeaways, HMOs). Energy and Sustainability Assessment (major and renewable schemes). Equality and Diversity Impact Statement (changes to employment, community or public buildings without a DAS). Materials (shopfronts, conservation areas, listed buildings, Green Belt). Open Space Details (residential). Planning Statement incl. Statement of Community Involvement (major, Green Belt, listed building). Playing Pitch / Sports Justification (loss of playing fields, artificial pitches). Site Treatment and Management Plan (applications including demolition).
issues.evidence: 2024 list items 1, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 11, 23, 26, 30, 31, 34 (same items appear in the 2020/2023 list)

issues.detail: Grokbot is missing the requirements that are new in the current 28 March 2024 list. Biodiversity Net Gain Strategy (major from 12 Feb 2024, minor from 2 April 2024, with exemptions). Fiddlers Ferry Policy Compliance Statement (within the MD3 allocation). Green Belt Compensation Scheme (inappropriate development in the Green Belt). Green Belt Statement (House Extensions), for householder development in the Green Belt with volume, floorspace and footprint calculations. Groundwater Risk Assessment (Source Protection Zones). Mineral Resource Assessment (Mineral Safeguarding Area, or within 250m of safeguarded infrastructure). Parameter Plans (all outline applications). South East Warrington Urban Extension Compliance Statement (MD2). Warrington Waterfront Policy Compliance Statement.
issues.claude_response: Grok could not verify this, so the finding stands until someone checks it by hand.

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none) - national requirements only', but the source sets householder-specific local requirements. Para 1.28 asks for extra information in Flood Zone 2/3, where bats or newts may be affected, for listed buildings, in the Green Belt or a conservation area, and where protected trees are involved. Section 3 lists a Planning Statement (Green Belt), Heritage Statement, tree works details, a Flood Water Management Scheme and an Ecological Statement with bat-survey triggers for householder applications. The 2024 list adds a Green Belt Statement (House Extensions).
issues.evidence: Para 1.28 and Section 3 'Requirements by Application Type'; 2024 item 18 'Householder development in the Green Belt'

issues.detail: Several other application types are recorded as '(none)' even though the source applies local requirements to them. Listed building consent needs a Heritage Statement, Structural Survey, Photographs and a Planning Statement for listed building applications. Works to trees needs a Tree Works Specification and Photographic Evidence for TPO and conservation-area trees. Demolition in a conservation area needs Photographs, a Structural Survey and a Site Treatment and Management Plan. Reserved matters can need a Fire Statement and Coal Mining Risk Assessment exclusions apply. Outline needs Parameter Plans (2024).
issues.evidence: Items 'Trees Specification of Works and Photographic Evidence: works to protected trees'; 'Photographs: demolition in conservation areas, listed building works'; 'Structural Survey: demolition of listed buildings...'

issues.detail: Fire Statement is placed under Outline, but the source expressly excludes outline applications. It applies to full and reserved matters applications for 2+ dwellings or educational accommodation of 18m+ or 7+ storeys.
issues.evidence: Fire Statement: 'Any application (excluding outline apps) that would result in two or more dwellings or educational accommodation...'

issues.detail: 'Biodiversity / Swift bricks / bird & bat boxes' is placed under Change of use - prior approval, but the source says the opposite: ecology statements are not required with Prior Notification applications.
issues.evidence: 'Prior Notification applications Ecology Statements will not be required with Prior Notification applications'

issues.detail: Grokbot put about 34 rows under Full planning with an 'INFERRED' note, although the source has a Section 3 that sets out requirements by application type. Examples: Arboricultural Impact Assessment uses tree-works (TPO) text. Telecommunications information also applies to prior approval. Schedule of works (listed building) belongs to listed building consent. Heritage, Ecology and Flood items also apply to householder applications.
issues.evidence: Notes on every Full planning row: 'INFERRED: application type not named in extracted text...'; source Section 3 p.38-41

issues.detail: Grokbot captured 14 tab_items, and all of them are process or boilerplate text rather than requirements. They include drawing scale and orientation advice, file size limits (10MB/25MB), file naming examples, scanning dpi, paper copy and CD/DVD instructions, a table-of-contents fragment ('Appendices Page 2 of 49 Introduction 4 ...'), validation dispute text, data protection advice about third-party information, a covering letter tip, a Planning Portal forms link, and a glossary definition of the Conservation of Habitats Regulations.
issues.evidence: tab_items sections 'Drawing / document standards', 'Submission rules', 'Policy-driven requirements' contain e.g. 'Maximum single file size is 10 Mbytes'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are taken from the wrong requirement or from submission rules. 'Block plan', 'Design and Access Statement' and 'Photographs' use file-naming and dpi text. 'Agricultural Land Classification' runs into AQMA map text. 'Arboricultural Impact Assessment' uses tree-works text ('arboriculturist's report if the work required relates to the condition of the tree'). 'Structural Survey' uses Site Treatment Plan text. 'Street scene' uses the demolition/structural survey trigger. 'Cycle parking' and 'EV charging' run into Open Space text. 'S106 Heads of Terms' uses the Affordable Housing text. 'Viability' is just 'below). (See Viability Assessment below if applicable). 2.' and 'Ecological Survey' is just 'to this protected species.'.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows trigger_excerpt fields vs source items (e.g. Street Scene Elevations trigger in source: 'Residential infill; major residential with varied house types; new development in conservation areas')

issues.detail: Some Grokbot requirement categories do not exist in the source; they were matched on stray keywords. 'Daylight / Sunlight / Overshadowing Assessment' comes from a tree-survey bullet ('Sunlight and shading'). 'Tall buildings / Wind microclimate assessment' comes from 'lighting to tall buildings' under Lighting/Floodlighting. 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' is actually the floodlighting assessment text. The list has no daylight, wind or advert-illumination requirement.
issues.evidence: Lighting/Floodlighting item: 'Floodlighting schemes and lighting to tall buildings'

issues.detail: The same source text is reused for several rows. 'Block plan / Site plan' and 'Design and Access Statement' have identical trigger text. 'Advertisement drawings' and 'Lighting Assessment' both use the floodlighting text. 'Cycle parking' and 'EV charging' both use the Parking and Access text, which in the source is one item.
issues.evidence: Parking and Access Details: one item 'including provision for cycle storage and electrical charging points'

summary: Grokbot links the superseded June 2020 checklist (amended Oct 2023); the current list was adopted 28 March 2024, and a 2026 draft has been consulted on. Its extraction is poor: tab_items are all boilerplate, many named local requirements are missing (13 long-standing items and 9 new 2024 items), triggers are mismatched, and householder, LBC and tree-works requirements are wrongly marked as none.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
